dedupe_keys.name: thermodynamic model of a hyperscale data centre hdc tdm

description: The code authors publish HDC-TDM, a Python thermodynamic model of a hyperscale data centre. Zenodo archives version 0.1 under Apache 2.0 and links the public repository. Its README identifies an example outdoor-temperature input, a corresponding output CSV and a main script. The model switches between indirect-airside free cooling and chiller operation according to ambient temperature, with equations documented in the describing study. It has supplied data-centre waste-heat inputs to a Danish energy-system analysis. This model can compare cooling demand and recoverable heat under weather scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Python implementation. Coverage is a configured facility and input weather, not all data-centre equipment classes. A limitation is that the README does not establish calibration against measured thermal performance or current equipment efficiency. Code was not installed or run, and its Danish study results were not reproduced.
